question: What is the keyboard shortcut to go to 'Home tab' in MS-Powerpoint?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alt+H**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 

 Keys
 Functions
 
 

 Ctrl + H
 Replace button on the ribbon
 
 

 Alt + M
 Opens the Mailings tab in the Ribbon
 
 

 Ctrl + M
 Insert New Slide
 
 

 **Alt + H**
 **Go to the Home tab**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Some other important keys and functions are:**

 
 

 Keys
 Functions
 
 

 Ctrl + N
 Create New Presentation
 
 

 Ctrl + A
 To select all the objects
 
 

 Ctrl + C
 Copy the selected text, object, or selected slide
 
 

 Ctrl + V
 To paste the selected objects
 
 

 Ctrl + O
 Open an existing presentation document
 
 

 Ctrl + Z
 To undo an action
 
 

 Ctrl + Y
 To redo an action
 
 

 F5
 To play the presentation from the start
 
 

 Esc
 To end the slideshow
 
 

 Shift + F5
 To start the presentation from the current slide
